bullets: Stop Wasted Trips & Monitor from Indoors: No more walking out to an empty mailbox in the pouring rain or freezing snow. This wireless mailbox sensor is a life-saver for seniors with mobility issues and busy professionals. It accurately detects the moment the mail carrier opens the lid, saving you unnecessary trips and keeping you warm and dry indoors.

Triple Real-Time Alerts: App Push, Visual LED & Audible Chime Stay informed your way. The moment your mailbox sensor is triggered, receive an instant app push notification on your smartphone, no matter where you are. Simultaneously, the indoor receiver emits a clear chime and flashes a bright blue LED—perfect for seniors or noisy environments. The LED continues to flash until acknowledged, ensuring you never overlook a delivery. Customize your experience with 3 selectable melodies to suit your preference.

Easy Installation: The mailbox alarm is battery-powered and wire-free for easy installation. It is compatible with various mailbox types including standard, wall-mounted, and slot mailboxes, allowing you to easily adjust settings based on your mailbox type.

IP65 Waterproof & Engineered for Extreme Weather: Designed for heavy-duty outdoor use, our outdoor mailbox sensor features an IP65 waterproof rating and high-temperature resistance. From -4°F to 140°F, it performs reliably through torrential rain, blizzards, and scorching sun. The rugged UV-resistant casing ensures the device won't degrade over years

Long-Distance Transmission, Accurate Detection: Upgrade your home security with our long-range mailbox alert system. Utilizing a powerful 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi connection, this device maintains a strong link to your home network over extensive distances.
